summary: Ultrapar Participações S.A. filed a material notice on Form 6-K announcing a share buyback program approved by its Board of Directors on June 17, 2026. The program authorizes the repurchase of up to 18 million common shares (1.61% of share capital) over 12 months starting June 18, 2026. Shares may be used for stock-based incentive plans, held in treasury, canceled, or sold. Repurchases will occur on the stock exchange in the cash market, with potential use of swaps as derivatives. No price or premium is specified. This is a capital return via open-market repurchases. Watch execution pace and any subsequent cancellation.
